note: Kept by hand. The verdicts of the in-game review of the screen grounds: one per tile class, outdoors and indoors, from captures of the running game at the play camera, 1.1 m above the ground and from above (Scripts/PhotorealQA/ground_script.py; sheets in Docs/Verification/GroundReview_13Nov2026 and GroundFixes_14Nov2026). Scripts/art_coverage.py screen_ground_state() counts a screen ground final only when every tile class on it has verdict "pass" here. A class that is absent was not looked at and does not pass.

rule.note: The one switch. false: no screen ground counts final by this rule, whatever the verdicts (every ground stays placeholder unless an art manifest dresses its screen). Whether grounds may count final by rule is the owner's decision; art_coverage.py --ground-rule on|off overrides this value for one run.
